[[The Desolation/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic3 = [[File:The Desolation signpost.jpg|150px]] | pic3-text = The Desolation [[signpost]]. }} [[The Desolation]] is situated on the northwestern portion of [[Elona]], connected to the [[Crystal Desert]]. It is one of the most hostile regions on [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]] due to its [[Sulfurous Haze|sulfurous sands]]. It is riddled with poisonous sulfur deserts and is home to many [[undead]] creatures and the great [[Junundu]] [[wurm]]s. The land was once under the rule of [[Palawa Joko]] but following his imprisonment the undead armies have gone through schisms and formed smaller groups. The Desolation was once the coast of the [[Crystal Sea]], and described as being a "valley of verdant growth." It was here that Abaddon was cast down by the other gods and banished into the [[Realm of Torment]]. His fall shattered and poisoned the land, turning it into what it is now. As the place where he was cast down, the Desolation is the part of Tyria closest to the Realm of Torment and it has begun to leak through and twist the already damaged lands. ==Towns and outposts== *[[Bone Palace]] *[[Lair of the Forgotten]] *[[The Mouth of Torment]] '''Mission outposts:''' *[[Gate of Desolation (outpost)|Gate of Desolation]] *[[Remains of Sahlahja (outpost)|Remains of Sahlahja]] *[[Ruins of Morah (outpost)|Ruins of Morah]] ==Missions== *[[Gate of Desolation]] *[[Ruins of Morah]] '''Challenge missions:''' *[[Remains of Sahlahja]] ==Explorable areas== *[[Crystal Overlook]] *[[Dynastic Tombs]] *[[Joko's Domain]] *[[Poisoned Outcrops]] *[[The Alkali Pan]] *[[The Ruptured Heart]] *[[The Shattered Ravines]] *[[The Sulfurous Wastes]] ==Landmarks== {{landmark list|The Desolation}} ==Soundtrack== *Black Sails at Dawn *Lost Dynasties *Turai's Legacy == Gallery == File:Bone Palace concept art.jpg File:"Sinkhole" concept art.jpg File:Nightfall screenshot 16.jpg File:Nightfall screenshot 1.jpg File:Nightfall screenshot 6.jpg ==Notes== {{gw2w}} *It is possible to completely run to every outpost in the Desolation other than Mouth of Torment without the aid of a Junundu. See the [[Desolation Run]] and [http://www.gwpvx.com/Build:Any/A_Desolation_Runner possible builds to use]. *The [[Sulfurous Haze]] death effect that affects characters who step onto the sulfur areas does not incur [[death penalty]] and does not spoil [[Survivor]] progress. *Various items from [[The Great Zehtuka]] can be found throughout the Desolation. *Creatures summoned through the use of a [[Summoning stone]] are immune to the effects of [[Sulfurous Haze]] and can thus travel with the party as normal. {{Continents nav}}
